title: JEPA-Inspired Latent Field Prediction for Sparse-Pilot MIMO-OFDM Channel Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2610.37391v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurate acquisition of full channel state information (CSI) is essential for multiple-input multiple-output orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (MIMO-OFDM) wireless systems, while dense pilot-based estimation incurs substantial overhead. Directly minimizing the prediction error over raw CSI coefficients is fragile in realistic propagation environments, since small-scale fading, mobility, local scattering, and small spatial perturbations can induce large phase-sensitive variations. Nevertheless, wireless channels contain strong spatial, temporal, and frequency-domain correlations that can be more predictably represented in a latent propagation-field domain. Motivated by this observation, we propose a joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA)-inspired field world model, defined as a latent predictive model of the wireless propagation field, for sparse-pilot channel reconstruction. translated_title: 受JEPA启发的潜在场预测用于稀疏导频MIMO-OFDM信道重构
translated_abstract: 对于多输入多输出正交频分复用（MIMO-OFDM）无线系统而言，准确获取完整的信道状态信息（CSI）至关重要，而基于密集导频的估计会带来巨大的开销。在现实的传播环境中，直接在原始CSI系数上最小化预测误差是脆弱的，因为小尺度衰落、移动性、局部散射以及微小的空间扰动都可能引起对相位敏感的大幅变化。尽管如此，无线信道包含强烈的空间、时间和频域相关性，这些相关性在潜在传播场域中可以得到更可预测的表示。受这一观察启发，我们提出了一种受联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）启发的场世界模型，将其定义为无线传播场的潜在预测模型，用于稀疏导频信道重构。该模型将CSI观测映射到潜在……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出一种受JEPA启发的无线传播场潜在世界模型，利用无线信道在潜在场域中更强的可预测相关性，从稀疏导频中稳健地重构MIMO-OFDM信道状态信息，克服了直接在原始CSI系数上预测的脆弱性。
en_tdlr: Proposes a JEPA-inspired latent propagation-field world model that exploits the more predictable spatial, temporal, and frequency correlations of wireless channels in a latent field domain, enabling robust MIMO-OFDM channel reconstruction from sparse pilots while overcoming the fragility of directly predicting raw CSI coefficients.
